title: Show HN: adamsreview – better multi-agent PR reviews for Claude Code
summary: adamsreview is a Claude Code plugin containing six slash commands that perform multi-stage, multi-agent PR reviews using parallel sub-agents, validation passes, and persistent JSON state, with optional ensemble review combining Codex CLI and PR bot comments for superior bug detection.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of inadequate PR review quality by using parallel multi-agent validation that catches more real bugs than built-in review tools while reducing false positives.
why_valuable: Its multi-stage parallel agent architecture with validation passes significantly outperforms single-pass review tools in bug detection accuracy, making code reviews more effective and reliable.
